subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Should maintainers adopt, replace, or close the stale linked Mattermost route-persistence PRs before starting any new repair work for #45082?
rationale: The remaining work is real, but the linked candidate branches already claim overlapping fixes and have merge conflicts, abandonment, or reviewed route/session risks that automation should not resolve as a product of issue triage alone.

options.title: Replace stale candidates
options.body: Use #45082 as the tracker for a fresh narrow route-persistence branch that preserves the correct thread-session entry and proves cron/heartbeat delivery in Mattermost.

options.title: Adopt and repair #52236
options.body: A maintainer can take over the draft branch if they also fix the known heartbeat and wrong-session risks and add live proof.

options.title: Close stale candidates only
options.body: Close obsolete or abandoned candidate PRs while leaving #45082 open for a future contributor or maintainer-sponsored fix.

recommendation.title: Replace stale candidates
recommendation.body: Use #45082 as the tracker for a fresh narrow route-persistence branch that preserves the correct thread-session entry and proves cron/heartbeat delivery in Mattermost.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the scoped message-tool replacement and explicitly called out that #45082 still needs wider proactive-message follow-up.
